findings.message:
[P1] Keep identified parts on the same storage key

The Chat Completions translators still store identified deltas under `chatOutputTextPartKey`, while this helper makes completed-part reconciliation use the output/content position whenever `output_index` exists. An identified `response.content_part.done` therefore misses the accumulated delta and emits the complete text again, duplicating normal assistant output.

src/chat/stream-translation.ts:80-80

[P2] Do not fall back across output positions

When the position lookup misses, this fallback treats the sole `item:` entry as the same part without checking its output/content position. If output 0 was streamed with an item id and output 1 only appears id-less in the terminal with the same text, output 1 is incorrectly discarded, so deduplication is still not scoped to the part position.

src/chat/stream-translation.ts:99-103

summary: Position-aware deduplication is applied inconsistently and still has a cross-position fallback that can discard distinct parts.

evidence: The added focused test covers two terminal id-less output items with equal text at different output indexes and verifies `haha`.
The implementation still falls back from a missing position to a sole `item:` entry without matching output/content position, so distinct parts are not always preserved.
The new position storage key is not used by the Chat Completions delta accumulators, causing normal identified completed parts to be emitted again.
